Plants of the World Online account: Ochna thomasiana Engl. & Gilg.

The native range of this species is S. Somalia to E. Tanzania (incl. Zanzibar, Pemba). It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome. It is has environmental uses.
